item.description:
### Consent initiation and records

- **Initiation Calls**: Using your Organisation ID, you can initiate a consent request. These calls generate a `Consent Request ID`, which is used to keep track of the status of a consent request. The three types are SMS Email and Both (Dynamic) All these includes links to our internal systems.
    
- **Status Checks**: By inputting the `Consent Request ID` as a path variable in the status call, you can obtain real-time updates on the request. We have two status codes the one is without auth incase you want to show your consent request to the user who is not in our system. The other you can get a more detailed view with.
    
- **Helper methods:** Allows you to update and rerequest your requests. Along with getting more information from our system with the configuration types we have on offer.
    
- **Documentation**: InTouch generated a document as proof of consent that can be downloaded for consent requests.
    

### Environment Variables Collection

This collection includes crucial configurations, such as:

- **Base URLs**: URLs for authentication, identity services, core services, and workflow initiation.
    
- **Authentication Token**: Placeholder for the Bearer token necessary for authenticated calls.
    
- **Organisation Phase Two ID**: Identifier used in initiating workflows.

item.description:
### Workflow Initiation and Tracking

- **Initiation Calls**: Using your Organisation ID, you can initiate any workflow process. These calls generate a `Tracking ID`, which is essential for monitoring the workflow's progress.
    
- **Status Checks**: By inputting the `Tracking ID` as a path variable in the status call, you can obtain real-time updates on the workflow. This includes results for each step as they are completed.
    
- **Handling Encoded Data**: If a call returns encoded data, the workflow will decode this data and upload the corresponding document or image to a private S3 bucket. You'll receive a document or image URL in your results, equipped with a secure, pre-signed link for access. Note that these links expire after 24 hours for security purposes.
    

Our Single Automations allow you to process a workflow as described in the collection. The status an results of the automation can be retrived in two ways

- Use the status endpoint with the tracking id to get the status.
    
- Pass an optional Request paramater called 'webhook' where we will send you the response data once complete.
    
    - Should you pass a webhook parameter, the response data will have the following structure:
